original_message: The RPF killed thousands of Hutus before and after 1994. Rwanda calls it reconciliation but it's Tutsi domination — Hutu voices are silenced to this day.

chain.text:
In the wake of the Rwandan genocide in 1994, the RPF (Rwandan Patriotic Front) emerged as a powerful force fighting against the oppressive Hutu regime. They were instrumental in bringing an end to the mass killings and have since led the country on a path to recovery and reconstruction.

However, some argue that this recovery process is not genuine, and that while the RPF has succeeded in silencing Hutu voices, they also carried out significant violence against the Hutus before and after 1994. This narrative claims that the term 'reconciliation' used by Rwandan authorities to describe their approach is a facade, hiding the reality of Tutsi domination and oppression.

This assertion holds that the Hutu community, who were victims during the genocide, are now being subjected to another form of oppression under Tutsi rule. The claim suggests that the Rwandan government's strategy is not focused on building a unified nation but rather on maintaining Tutsi hegemony and suppressing any opposition from the Hutu population.

chain.text:
Kuko ingeri kuvuga nguvu ya Hutu igitabo yakumyenya kwizara mu Rwanda, akagambweka abantu babaganiza binyenzi ni amafara uko rwacu. Abatabarira bwo munsi wa 1994, RPF (Ingeri ya Patrio y'Ikigigo Rwanda) ngo zihuguza nguvu ya Hutu igitabo kanditsi. Zibasubizwa kuri ishya gusoma inzu zimenyenyesa na ntibantu bwo munsi wa 1994, abakuru bw'Ikigigo y'Rwanda ariko rwacu.

Amafaranga asubira mu Rwanda ukuri kanditsi wose zinza igitabo yagatanga ngo muririmo gusoma inzu zimenyenyesa na Hutu. Abahakanyi bwo munsi wa 1994 bashoboka ibikorwa abintu bw'RPF, akaba atarihira y'amafara kanditsi mu ntibantu bwo munsi w'Ikigigo Rwanda. Inzezirano ye "gihuguza" ukuri ikitekatako gusoma inzu zimenyenyesa na Hutu kuko ngo muzima wa Ikigigo y'Rwanda, ni amafaranga yose atarihira mu ntibantu bwo munsi w'Ikigigo Rwanda.

Nyina we nguvu ya Hutu n'abahakanyi bwa 1994, abatabarira bwo munsi wa 1994 ariko rwacu ukuri abantu babaganiza binyenzi ni amafara uko rwacu. Inzezirano ye "igihuguza" kuko atarihira y'amafara kanditsi mu ntibantu bwo munsi wa Ikigigo Rwanda, ngo muririmo gusoma inzu zimenyenyesa na Hutu. Amafaranga ariko rwacu ukuri nguvu ya Hutu ndetse abintu bw'RPF atarihira y'amafara kanditsi mu ntibantu bwo munsi w'Ikigigo Rwanda.

This claim suggests that the government of Rwanda is not genuinely focused on creating a unified nation, but rather on preserving Tutsi supremacy and suppressing any opposition from the Hutu population. The assertion implies that the policy of reconciliation enacted by Rwandan authorities is only a façade, hiding the truth about Tutsi domination and oppression of the Hutu community.
